claim: Borderline chain / large-firm entries: Partners Personnel (313 State St), SportsMed Physical Therapy (271 King St), Ginarte (352 New Brunswick Ave), Garces Grabler & LeBrocq (502 Amboy Ave)
problem: Not clearly excluded but poor fits under the chain rule. Partners Personnel is a multi-state staffing chain with one NJ office here; SportsMed is a roughly 30-clinic NJ group; Ginarte is a 30-attorney NY/NJ firm; Garces Grabler is a multi-office state-wide PI firm. None is a local owner-operated shop.
fix: Keep only if the team wants multi-office brands; otherwise deprioritise or drop, and state the rule consistently.

claim: Central Jersey Medical Center (275 Hobart St) and The Lupo Group (563B Amboy Ave, brokered by eXp Realty)

fix: Make an explicit keep/drop call and record the reason, so the zone's list is internally consistent.
